latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the "gitee-create-release" skill:

- Publishes well-structured releases and auto-generates changelogs on Gitee using MCP Server.
- Guides users to confirm version numbers following Semantic Versioning.
- Retrieves existing releases and merged PRs to prepare accurate changelogs.
- Categorizes changes (breaking, features, fixes, etc.) and generates a markdown changelog template.
- Presents the changelog for user confirmation before creating the release.
- Supports pre-release tags and notifies users with a release link after publishing.
